# frontend — LLM doc index (pinned: 1.4.3)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches
# the running build (chart version == image tag == the repo tag; no v prefix).
docs/index.md: the map — what frontend is + links to the whole bundle and the deep corpus
docs/overview.md: what it does and how it works — the server-driven widget model, nginx runtime, charts, platform peers
docs/usage.md: install via the Krateo installer pin or direct helm install oci://…; local render recipe; local dev + examples portal
docs/configuration.md: the whole config surface — chart values, the rendered config.json contract, port wiring, preview sandbox
docs/api.md: the 43 widget CRDs + the shared widget spec model; the container's HTTP surface
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships — one plain-semver tag drives image + both charts; the crds-subchart seam
docs/log.md: curated history
builder-gate/README.md: the builder gate — validate_draft MCP service (portal lint, references, snowplow jq, live dry-run, data as the caller) + helm/builder-gate
examples/hello-page/README.md: a convention Flex page (page-hello) with a Paragraph + Button; routes-as-data
examples/hello-page/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
examples/namespaces-table/README.md: a Table fed by a RESTAction over the Kubernetes API (widgetDataTemplate jq rows)
examples/namespaces-table/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
# Deep corpus (code-adjacent, authoritative for internals; indexed in detail by ui/docs/llms.txt):
ui/docs/llms.txt: the agent index of the internals corpus (version-pinned retrieval procedure)
ui/docs/architecture.md: how the SPA is built — widget registry, WidgetRenderer, data-fetch, Shell + routes-as-data. Read first for internals
ui/docs/behavior.md: runtime behavior — config.json contract, upstream contracts, auth/tokens, bootstrap, actions, events, live refresh
ui/docs/gotchas.md: real runtime pitfalls grounded in the code/config
ui/docs/widget-authoring.md: the schema.json → types/CRD pipeline, scaffolding, antd-fidelity rules
ui/docs/widgets-api-reference.md: generated per-widget reference of all 43 kinds (npm run update-readme-widgets)
ui/docs/docs.md: the widget concept — widgetData, widgetDataTemplate, actions, resourcesRefs(Template)
ui/docs/form-values.md: Form initialValues semantics (precedence, drafts, re-seed)
ui/docs/restactions.md: pointer — RESTActions are snowplow's; how widgets consume them
ui/docs/cr-migration-map.json: the hard-break CR migration map (legacy kinds/props → current; List/DataGrid → Listy)
ui/docs/guides/simple-page/simple-page.md: worked guide — Button + convention Flex page + sidebar Menu item
ui/docs/guides/action-button/action-button.md: worked guide — openDrawer action, then a Form rest action
# Records (dated; frontmatter-flagged — re-verify against code before relying on them):
ui/docs/antd-migration-plan.md: the executed antd-fidelity migration decision record (status: diverged — Listy note inside)
ui/docs/autocomplete-and-dependencies.md: removed-feature note (Form autocomplete/dependencies no longer exist)
